name: v5.0.0 — Windows GUI installer
body:
First official GUI release of the Cursor Enterprise Framework installer. Includes a self-contained Windows installer (`cursor-setup.exe`, ~412 KB, no .NET required) and the framework payload (`cursor-setup.zip`, 21.09 MB / 605 files). See RELEASE-NOTES-v5.0.0.md for full details.

Highlights:
- WinForms GUI with progress + extraction log
- Self-contained .NET 8 single-file publish
- ZIP sidecar architecture (reusable with PowerShell quick-install)
- Built-in file-count verification after install

Verified counts: 42 rules, 42 skills, 8 agents, 329 knowledge files, 28 commands, 31 prompts.
